comment: Palutena's low detail (every VS battle draws it): triangles per object of the owner's approved Blender model (the 2026-10-20 base, 3DS_to_DS_Palutena_v2.blend) after scripts/p6/look_reduce.py. drop_parts_up_to: the shoes' stiletto heel blocks (separate six-triangle pieces, about a pixel in battle) go; relax_uv: the shoes' UV islands would block every collapse; class_min: the leg tubes keep five sides at the hips and knees, four at the ankles (rows 16-18, 21-23; owner 2026-10-20: four at the hip dropped a different corner than at the knee, a twisted thigh that looked 'much bigger around at the top'); keep_outline: the face keeps its front outline; keep_classes: the dress's skirt (row 1) stays whole, look_skirt.py rebuilds it from its hem and slit; keep_points: the hair cap's ring in front of and beside the face's crown point (owner 2026-10-20: 'head point poking out of top of hair looking like a horn'); flip_slivers: the chest's sliver triangles under the arms turn their long edge (owner 2026-10-20: 'triangles under armpit can be simplified').
